title: VisionUiCheckRequest
description: vision.ui-check-request@1: the JSON body of POST /api/v1/ui-check on OpenVibe.Vision (Design's Arena and signed-in people; HTML, URL and screenshot checks also work anonymously). Send exactly one source: `html` with the markup, `url` with a public http(s) page, `image` with a data URL, or `image_url` with a public image URL. The multipart form field `image` is the same screenshot source. `viewport` defaults to 1280x800 and is clamped to 160..10000; the check executes no JavaScript and fetches only a public URL through the SSRF guard.

html.description: The HTML to check, including any inline CSS.

url.description: A public page to fetch and check.

image.description: A screenshot as an image data URL.
